description: Implement new technology to manage volunteer information, progress on-boarding program for newly hired employees and engage in all aspects of Human Resources.
Improve how the organization manages its volunteer information and approvals by learning, implementing, and training others on a new computer program.
Successfully oversee the volunteer approval process which includes background screening. Re-screen 1000+ new volunteers and 1000+ existing volunteers each year to ensure a safe environment for girls.
Design new employee packages and send them via mail and email.
Conducted benefits administration for benefit-eligible employees.
Worked with senior-level management to create fair and consistent HR policies and procedures. Developed an employee handbook, including content and layout.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate has a robust background in Human Resources, with specific expertise in volunteer management and employee onboarding. Their experience includes the implementation of new technology for record-keeping and background screening processes. Additionally, they have contributed to HR policy development through their roles in both leadership and generalist capacities across different sectors.
